mfa.heading: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.challenge-instructions: Enter the 6-digit confirmation code from your authentication app.
mfa.description: Multi-factor authentication is an extra layer of security for your account. It requires you to enter a verification code from an app on your phone when you sign in.
mfa.disable-description: Disable multi-factor authentication for your account.
mfa.disable-success: Multi-factor authentication has been disabled. You no longer need to enter a verification code when signing in.
mfa.qr-code-alt: QR code for setting up multi-factor authentication
mfa.qr-description: Use a free authentication app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy) to scan this QR code and set up your account.
mfa.add-to-app-description: Opens your authenticator app on this phone.
mfa.setup-key-description: In your authenticator app, choose to enter a key, then paste or type this key there.
mfa.setup-key-toggle: Can't scan the code? Use a setup key
mfa.setup-key-toggle-handheld: App didn't open? Use a setup key
mfa.qr-toggle: Show QR code for another device
mfa.recovery-code-description: Write down these recovery codes in a safe place. You will need them to sign in if you lose your phone. This is the only time you will see them.
mfa.recovery-code-instructions: Enter one of your recovery codes to sign in. Each code can only be used once.
mfa.recovery-codes-lost: Your recovery codes were shown once, when you set up MFA. Lost them? Regenerate them: you will see the new codes once, and the old ones stop working.
mfa.recovery-codes-regenerate-description: New recovery codes replace your current ones, which stop working straight away. You will see the new codes only once, so have a safe place ready to store them.
mfa.recovery-codes-unavailable: Your recovery codes could not be loaded, so the code was not confirmed yet. Try again.
mfa.recovery-codes-missing: Your recovery codes could not be shown. Create new ones in your account settings with “{action}”.
mfa.setup-description: Add a second step to signing in, so nobody can get into your account with your password alone.
mfa.setup-required-description: Multi-factor authentication is required for your account. Set it up to continue.
mfa.organization-required-description: Everyone in your organization has to set up multi-factor authentication before they can use the platform. Managers always need it.
mfa.organization-required-on: Multi-factor authentication is now required for your organization.
mfa.organization-required-off: Multi-factor authentication is no longer required for your organization.
mfa.change-app-description: To move to a new authenticator app or phone, multi-factor authentication is switched off and you set it up again straight away. Until then you can only use the setup page.
mfa.session-expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.

password-confirmation.title: Confirm your password
password-confirmation.description: For your security, enter your password before you change your multi-factor authentication settings.

auth.confirm-logout: Are you sure you want to sign out?

password.email-sent: We have emailed your password reset link.
password.forgot-instructions: Enter your email to reset your password.
password.heading: Password
password.reset-description: Are you sure you want to update your password? Enter a new strong password.
password.reset-form-instructions: Click the link in the password reset email.
password.saved: Your new password has been saved.
password.updated: Your password has been updated. You will be signed in automatically.

requirements.description: Password must meet the following criteria:
requirements.length: Must be at least {n} characters long
requirements.length-invalid: Password does not meet length requirement
requirements.breached: Must not appear in a known data breach
requirements.common: Must not be a commonly used password
requirements.context: Must not contain your name, email or the platform name
